pages.text: SYN Daily Ledger compares fund performance over the past year. Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned. The development follows a year in which small investors have shown growing interest in formal products. The Kifaru Bond Fund charged 1.9 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 1,000. The Chui Equity Fund charged 3.0 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 500.

The Jua Balanced Fund charged 1.9 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 5,000. The Duma Money Market Fund charged 1.4 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 500. The Twiga Equity Fund charged 2.4 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 1,000. The Kasuku Equity Fund charged 2.1 percent a year, with a minimum of SYN Sh 500.
